name: High Branches historian
design: Tall elderly male with long smooth worn bronze biomask, low hornless brow and broad squared lower plate, sparse grey thick tendrils falling past shoulders. Long forest-green split mantle with fringed cream geometric border over slate high-neck tunic and brown leggings, simple silver bracers. Cradles two narrow CLOSED bound record volumes stacked at abdomen, short cylindrical reader strapped to left hip and a weathered brown scroll satchel at right.
